mapper.insert: INSERT INTO contributor_request ( user_id, status, requested_at, reviewed_at, reviewed_by, review_comment, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{status}, #{requestedAt}, #{reviewedAt}, #{reviewedBy}, #{reviewComment}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT request_id, user_id, status, requested_at, reviewed_at, reviewed_by, review_comment, created_at, updated_at FROM contributor_request WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY created_at DESC, request_id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT request_id, user_id, status, requested_at, reviewed_at, reviewed_by, review_comment, created_at, updated_at FROM contributor_request WHERE request_id = #{requestId}
SELECT request_id, user_id, status, requested_at, reviewed_at, reviewed_by, review_comment, created_at, updated_at FROM contributor_request WHERE request_id = #{requestId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE contributor_request SET status = #{status}, reviewed_at = #{reviewedAt}, reviewed_by = #{reviewedBy}, review_comment = #{reviewComment}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE request_id = #{requestId}
mapper.select: SELECT cr.request_id, cr.user_id, cr.reviewed_by, u.name AS user_name, u.email AS user_email, cr.status, cr.review_comment, cr.requested_at, cr.reviewed_at, cr.created_at, cr.updated_at FROM contributor_request cr INNER JOIN app_user u ON u.user_id = cr.user_id WHERE cr.request_id = #{requestId}

SELECT cr.request_id, cr.user_id, cr.reviewed_by, u.name AS user_name, u.email AS user_email, cr.status, cr.review_comment, cr.requested_at, cr.reviewed_at, cr.created_at, cr.updated_at FROM contributor_request cr INNER JOIN app_user u ON u.user_id = cr.user_id WHERE cr.status = 'PENDING' ORDER BY cr.requested_at ASC, cr.request_id ASC
